Description: A unique alphanumeric identifier for each gamer.
The age of the player, ranging from 16 to 40 years old.
The category of the game played during the session (MOBA, FPS, Battle Royale, or Fighting).
The duration of the current gaming session in hours, used to measure fatigue.
The number of hours the player slept the night before the session.
The number of energy drinks (caffeine) consumed before or during the match.
The brightness setting of the player's monitor as a percentage (contains ~5% missing values).
Indicates whether a blue light filter was active on the screen (Yes / No).
Actions Per Minute. A measure of how many inputs (clicks/keystrokes) the player performs per minute.
The player's average heart rate in beats per minute during the match.
Heart Rate Variability score (10-100). Higher scores generally indicate less physiological stress and better recovery (contains ~2% missing values).
The player's average reaction time measured in milliseconds (ms).
The final result of the gaming match (Win / Loss).
